title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; parity + version bump v1.57.0
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: SDKs had small but impactful behavioral differences across Python, TypeScript and Go in auth token refresh, retry/backoff behavior, and streaming reconnect ergonomics. This caused customer regressions when switching runtimes or when using Dedicated/Private fallbacks. This PR unifies: 1) auth token refresh hooks and default TTL safety windows; 2) retry policy semantics (idempotency detection, jittered exponential backoff, non-blocking retry for streaming); 3) streaming API ergonomics (resume tokens, reconnection backoff, and explicit Close/Done semantics). Changeset: - Standardized AuthProvider interface and adapters in each SDK so token caching + refresh follow same TTL-buffer semantics. - Introduced a small RetryPolicy abstraction used by HTTP and streaming transports; defaults match production server SLOs (max_retries=5, initial_backoff=100ms, max_backoff=5s, full_jitter). - Streaming changes: provide an explicit ResumeToken object, preserve partial events on reconnect, and make client reconnect non-blocking; improved docs and examples for both long-lived and ephemeral streams. - Parity fixes and version bumps: python v1.57.0, typescript v1.57.0, go v1.57.0; changelogs updated. Testing: unit tests added for token refresh edge cases, e2e streaming reconnect simulation harness in benchmark-lab, cross-language integration tests in the eval-harness. CI: initial run failed lint on TS (streaming API docs typos) and a flaky Go test around backoff timers; fixed and reran — all checks passed. Notes: - No API surface breaking changes for existing consumers; all defaults preserve previous behavior except tightening token-safety-window which prevents token expiry-on-send for low-latency calls (should be strictly safer). - This PR consolidates earlier smaller parity PRs and should reduce future drift. Checklist: - [x] Standardize AuthProvider across SDKs - [x] Introduce RetryPolicy with documented defaults - [x] Streaming resume semantics + examples - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] Update changelogs and bump versions - [x] Run full CI and address failures Related: ENG-4123 (unify SDK retry semantics), ENG-4207 (streaming reconnect improvements), SUP-881 (support escalations for streaming disconnects).

Marta Lopez (review): The Go backoff flake shows in CI; please use time.Now().UnixNano() vs time.Now() for monotonic clock or use time.Since reference. Also a minor nit on exported function docstrings.

release_notes: SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) v1.57.0: Unified auth token refresh, standardized retry policies with jittered exponential backoff, improved streaming resume and reconnection ergonomics. Backwards-compatible defaults. See individual CHANGLOGs for details.
notes_on_migration: Most users will not need to change code. If you relied on previous aggressive token expiration behavior, you may see fewer 401s on in-flight requests.
To adjust retry aggressiveness set RW_SDK_MAX_RETRIES or use the RetryPolicy builder in your SDK of choice.
Streaming: use Stream.ResumeToken for resuming; examples in examples/streaming/resume-example.md
